title: Tesla Will Open Model S/X Design Materials and Software, Further Shifting Strategic Focus to AI
excerpt: On August 4, Tesla Vice President Tao Lin re-tweeted a plan previously announced by Elon Musk, stating that Tesla will open up the design documents and software
content_html:
On August 4, Tesla Vice President Tao Lin re-tweeted a plan previously announced by Elon Musk, stating that Tesla will open up the design documents and software of the Model S and Model X to car owners, repair shops, and engineering enthusiasts, facilitating the study of the technical details of these two flagship models and further enhancing product technical transparency and repair support capabilities.

Previously, Musk had announced on April 1st on the X platform that Tesla had stopped accepting new customization orders for Model S and Model X vehicles worldwide. This opening of design documents is seen as an important measure following the gradual withdrawal of these classic models from the core product line.

However, stopping customization of the flagship models does not mean that Tesla is weakening its automotive business. According to official disclosures, the company is further shifting its strategic focus towards "Physical AI." The original Model S/X production lines at the Fremont factory have been dismantled and renovated, and are now used for the production of Optimus humanoid robots, providing manufacturing capacity for expanding the robot business.

In the future, Tesla will continue to increase its investment in areas such as humanoid robots, autonomous driving, and AI chips, while the automotive business will still rely on main models like Model 3 and Model Y as sales pillars. This release of vehicle design documents also reflects that Tesla is gradually shifting its resources from traditional flagship models to AI-driven next-generation smart hardware and robot ecosystems.

content_html_zh:
8月4日，特斯拉副总裁陶琳转发了埃隆·马斯克此前宣布的计划，表示特斯拉将向车主、维修店和工程爱好者开放Model S和Model X的设计文档和软件，方便研究这两款旗舰车型的技术细节，进一步增强产品技术透明度和维修支持能力。

此前，马斯克曾于 4 月 1 日在 X 平台上宣布，特斯拉在全球范围内停止接受 Model S 和 Model X 车辆的新定制订单。 此次开放设计文件被视为继这些经典车型逐步退出核心产品线后的一项重要举措。

不过，停止旗舰车型定制并不意味着特斯拉正在削弱其汽车业务。 据官方披露，该公司正在进一步将战略重心转向“物理AI”。 弗里蒙特工厂原有的Model S/X生产线已被拆除和改造，现在用于生产Optimus人形机器人，为扩大机器人业务提供制造能力。

未来，特斯拉将继续加大在人形机器人、自动驾驶、AI芯片等领域的投入，而汽车业务仍将依靠Model 3、Model Y等主力车型作为销售支柱。 此次车辆设计文件的发布也反映出，特斯拉正逐步将资源从传统旗舰车型转向AI驱动的下一代智能硬件和机器人生态系统。
